deprecation_criterion: Superseded by the next prioritize housekeep wave's baseline; single-use measured-reduction reference, re-captured whenever a feature change legitimately alters the doc surfaces.
description: Line counts of prioritize doc surfaces, re-captured after issue #258 (PRIORITIZE reads the authoritative TRIAGE-stamped target_feature field, with a fallback re-derivation) legitimately changed docs/spec.md. The prior baseline (spec.md=153, contract.md=31, captured post-#257) recorded an honest doc-reduction NO-OP; this revision moves spec.md to the post-#258 surface (spec.md=154, contract.md unchanged at 31) because consuming the authoritative field is a genuine behaviour change (the resolved Deferred item was removed and the detection prose re-pointed at the field), not silent doc bloat. The housekeep e2e gates continue to assert behavior preserved, no load-bearing token dropped, and that the docs do not drift PAST this new baseline.
